source.locator: MD&A Business Overview p16; three-month comparison p17; six-month comparison p18

interpretation.averageCountCorroboration: H1 average trucks in service equals release company-driver plus owner-operator average counts in both years. This corroborates the count, not the full mileage/population/day join.

recommendation.reason: Recent six-month window with explicitly corroborated average counts; Q2 is an overlapping sensitivity, FY2025 is a full-year contrast, not additional activity to sum.
recommendation.assumption: For this contrast only, divide reported truckload mileage excluding power-only by the combined average company-driver and owner-operator trucks. Do not call the result observed owned-tractor productivity.
recommendation.rejectedReason: Numerator has not been split by company-driver and owner-operator mileage; dropping owner-operators from only the denominator inflates the contrast.

completionBoundary.researchDeliverable: Reproducible conditional km per average truck-month and source disagreement, linked to existing summary without a second engine.
completionBoundary.remainingEconomicDeliverable: Explicit public-model fleet/profile and compatible fixed budget, productive asset-days for MX/US/one box, then serial route cycle and variable costs.
